about_the_game:
Leap Galaxy is a 2D platformer with a minimalistic aesthetic and gameplay that puts speed and flow first. Take advantage of momentum and master the recoil of your shots to reach insane speeds and beat each level as fast as posible!

Key Features

  • Explore unique and creative mechanics that change the way you move across space.

  • Get through 8 worlds, each one with different environments, obstacles, and handmade challenges.

  • Obtain stars by beating levels quickly, and spend them to unlock new characters and color palettes.

  • Compete for the first place in the leaderboards against friends and the rest of the world.

New Ways to Move

In each of the 8 worlds you’ll discover a new way to move, like speed rings, gravity zones and even hook orbs. Every mechanic expands your movement possibilities, allowing you to make lightning fast runs through the levels!

Every Second Counts!

In Leap Galaxy, speed is everything. If you want to collect all stars you’ll need to fly through the levels and set new records. Compete with players across the globe in every planet’s final challenge, where you’ll have to go through all the world’s levels back to back and fight for a spot on the online leaderboards.

Leap in style

Unlock a wide variety of playable characters, each with their own distinct and charming animations. Not a fan of the default colors? No worries, we got you covered! Choose between a variety of unlockable color schemes to match your style.
